decisions.reason: Having survived several years as a multi-model extension of the core office range, this desk system still fits the firm's stated direction toward flexible workplace interiors and accumulated design and marketing commitment favors continuation.

The chair family remains close to the established offer and, after years on the market, prior investment and the ease of justifying it within a broad premium seating portfolio make withdrawal unlikely.

These floor cushions are more niche than the main furniture lines, but they still support the firm's design-led interiors concept and existing commitment to the line makes management more likely to continue than to abandon it.
The high standing table aligns with contemporary lounge and workplace use, and the firm's prior development effort and strategic emphasis on adaptable interiors support keeping it on the market.
